fields.mechanism: Excessive no-load current caused by an air gap larger than design specification increases the magnetizing component of stator current, producing I²R heating in the stator windings despite zero mechanical load and balanced phase resistance.
fields.intervention: Measure the rotor-to-stator air gap at multiple axial and circumferential positions; if out of tolerance, re-shim or replace bearings to restore the specified air gap, reducing the required magnetizing current.
fields.expected_effect: No-load stator current decreases to the nameplate-rated value, eliminating the thermal overload trip during 20-minute no-load running while maintaining stable 400V supply and balanced winding resistance.
fields.falsification_test: Measure the no-load line current with a true-RMS clamp meter before and after air gap correction; if the no-load current remains above 30 percent of full-load rated current after confirming nominal air gap dimensions, this mechanism is disproved.
